div.div:
Pursuant to Rule 13d-2 promulgated under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), this Amendment No. 13 to Schedule 13D (this "Amendment") amends the statement on Schedule 13D filed with the United States Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") on July 23, 2012 (as amended and supplemented prior to the date hereof, the "Original Schedule 13D" and, as amended and supplemented by this Amendment, the "Schedule 13D") by Fairfax Financial Holdings Limited and certain of its affiliates relating to the common shares, no par value ("Shares"), of BlackBerry Limited ("BlackBerry").
The following amendments to Items 2, 5 and 7 of the Original Schedule 13D are hereby made:

tr.td: Interest in Securities of the Issuer

td.div:
Based on the most recent information available, the aggregate number and percentage of the Shares (the securities identified by Item 1 of this Schedule 13D) that are beneficially owned by each of the Reporting Persons is set forth in boxes 11 and 13 of the second part of the cover page to this Schedule 13D for each of the Reporting Persons, and such information is incorporated herein by reference.
The percentage of Shares beneficially owned by each of the Reporting Persons was calculated based on 590,361,084 Shares issued and outstanding as of September 22, 2025, as reported by BlackBerry.

The numbers of Shares as to which each of the Reporting Persons has sole voting power, shared voting power, sole dispositive power and shared dispositive power is set forth in boxes 7, 8, 9 and 10, respectively, on the second part of the cover page to this Schedule 13D for each of the Reporting Persons, and such information is incorporated herein by reference.
To the best knowledge of the Reporting Persons, the persons listed in Exhibit 99.21 hereto beneficially own the amounts of Shares listed therein and have sole voting power and sole dispositive power with respect to such Shares.

Except as described herein, to the best of the knowledge of the Reporting Persons, none of the persons listed in Exhibit 99.22 hereto beneficially owns Shares or has acquired or disposed of any Shares in the past sixty days.
